_canonical: Option B (8 categories, equal 150). Chosen to make the '<=3 leads' rule satisfiable (8<=9) and totals equal. Alternatives A (equal-100) and C (difficulty-weighted) live in budget-options.json.
_rules: Each faction gets the same 150-point total budget across 8 power categories, distributed differently.
No faction is the sole #1 in more than three categories (D:3, Cov:3, Arr:2).
Ease of use is NOT a power category — it is a separate complexity tag.
Values are internal (not shown to players); they verify a faction isn't stacking too many advantages.

Directorate.profile: High durability, reliable economy, strong repair, strong combined arms, straightforward controls.

Covenant.profile: Fast expansion, harassment, stealth, cheap field presence, salvage, tactical flexibility.

Array.profile: Strong tech scaling, battlefield manipulation, shields, mobile infrastructure, specialists.

counterCoverage._rule: Every faction must answer each threat. The answer need not be equivalent.
